validity: Four 30-second measured legs used the same gameplay checkpoint, changing 960x720 images and both native logic-frame controller tracks; planned warmups excluded.
decision: Reject integer FIFO on this corrected configuration; it loses both paired visible-FPS comparisons and no leg reaches strict 60.
limits: One heavy matchup; machine-state replay for the FIFO flag exists in earlier work but was not repeated with low-detail models and this corrected renderer. No production default change follows.
